description: NASHUA, N.H. — Today, the National Federation of Independent Business NH PAC (NFIB NH PAC), New Hampshire’s leading small business political action committee, endorsed Governor Kelly Ayotte for re-election during a visit to Landscape Plus, a family-owned and operated business in Goffstown. “New Hampshire small businesses are proud to support Governor Kelly Ayotte for re-election […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Kelly for New Hampshire, Inc
title: NFIB New Hampshire Endorses Governor Ayotte - Kelly Ayotte for Governor
